Plan-review PASS 1 (G1G2 edit-set/scope accuracy): All named edit targets verified to exist — `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py` review_plan docstring (line 501, now P1-P11), `src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/__init__.py`, `.../review_kernel/discovery.py`, `.../prompting/prompts.py`, `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py`, `docs/mcp-reference.md`, `tests/unit/test_gen_mcp_reference.py`, and new `tests/unit/test_review_lifecycle_docs.py`. Sole description consumer (the doc generator) is in scope; `check_mcp_library_parity` keys on params/symbols not description prose, so it is correctly not a consumer. Frozen P1-P9 seam-boundary comments in `det_advisory.py`/`det_lint.py` are correctly excluded (KEEP allowlist + held-out test).

One unenumerated in-scope occurrence: `tests/unit/test_plan_review.py:3` docstring still says "the DET floor (P1-P9)" in the OVERALL-floor sense (not a seam-boundary), which is the same stale count this ticket corrects. It is within the plan's stated scope ("affected review/code-review source comments" and "its tests") but is not enumerated as an edit target nor pinned as KEEP. Recommend either correcting it to P1-P11 or explicitly classifying it out-of-scope with rationale.
